title: Prediction of Pre-operative Anxiety by Heart Variability and Pupillometry
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine whether heart rate variability levels and pupillometric measures are effective objective predictors of anxiety among patients before surgery.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

-Day case surgical patients

Exclusion Criteria:

* \<18yo
* psychiatric disorders
* participating refusal
study_population: Elective patients for day-case surgical procedure
